history.submitter_remarks: Former name Sai Kung Wing Wo Street (西貢永和街) attested in G.N.3038; originally item 9 of G.N.2462 of 1976.

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at is junction with Sai Kung Tai Street and running in an easterly direction for about 78 metres where it turns to run in a north-easterly direction for about 102 metres to terminate at its junction with Yi Chun Street as shown dotted black on Drawing No. NTA/SK/R10.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街道以與西貢大街之接連處為起點，向東伸展約七十八米，然後轉向東北伸展約一〇二米至與宜春街之交界處為終點；在 NTA/SK/R10 號圖則內以黑色小圓點顯示。
